stem: A plant is visibly wilted but its container is unusually heavy and wet. What is the best Technician I action?
choices: Apply more irrigation immediately because wilting always means drought
Document the contradictory plant/root-zone evidence and escalate rather than assuming more water is needed
Discard the container without recording it
rationale: Wilting can occur with a wet root zone. The contradiction should be documented and investigated instead of automatically adding water.
